plugins.label: Threshold
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Compare a value to a threshold. Outputs 0/1, inverted 0/1, or passes the value when true (gate). Richer than the built-in Threshold Gate.

properties.label: Output
properties.help: binary → 1 when condition holds. gate → original value when true, else 0. invert_binary flips the 0/1.

properties.label: Equal ε
properties.help: Tolerance used only when Mode is Equal

plugins.label: Deadzone
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Zero-out values whose absolute magnitude is below a threshold. Optional soft ramp. Different model from the built-in centre+radius deadzone.

properties.label: Deadzone
properties.help: Values with |value| < deadzone become 0 (or are scaled in soft mode)

properties.label: Soft edge
properties.help: If on, rescale so the deadzone is removed and the rest maps smoothly outward

plugins.label: Smooth (EMA)
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Exponential moving average — tames jittery sensors. Unique Slot per instance so parallel smoothers do not share state.

properties.label: Alpha
properties.help: 1 = no smoothing. Smaller = heavier lag. 0.15–0.3 is a good start for CPU/net.

properties.label: Slot
properties.help: Unique integer per Smooth node (1, 2, 3…). Shared slots share memory.

plugins.label: Temp Convert
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Convert temperature between Fahrenheit and Celsius.
plugins.lua_expr:
(function()
 local v = {value}
 local dir = '{direction}'
 local out
 if dir == 'c_to_f' then
 out = v * 9 / 5 + 32
 else
 out = (v - 32) * 5 / 9
 end
 local d = '{decimals}'
 if d == '0' then return math.floor(out + 0.5)
 elseif d == '1' then return math.floor(out * 10 + 0.5) / 10
 elseif d == '2' then return math.floor(out * 100 + 0.5) / 100
 end
 return out
end)()

plugins.label: Threshold Chain (10-Stage)
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Map one number onto up to 10 progressive stages. Output is a stage index. Drive image chains, pickers, glow triggers, etc.

properties.label: Mode
choice_labels: Exact band (step i if t[i] ≤ v < t[i+1])

plugins.lua_expr:
(function()
 local v = {value}
 if type(v) ~= 'number' then v = tonumber(v) or 0 end
 local count = math.floor({steps_count} + 0.5)
 if count < 1 then count = 1 elseif count > 10 then count = 10 end
 local t = { {t1}, {t2}, {t3}, {t4}, {t5}, {t6}, {t7}, {t8}, {t9}, {t10} }
 local mode = '{mode}'
 if mode == 'exact_band' then
 for i = 1, count do
 local lo = t[i]
 local hi = (i < count) and t[i + 1] or nil
 if type(lo) ~= 'number' then lo = tonumber(lo) or 0 end
 if hi ~= nil and type(hi) ~= 'number' then hi = tonumber(hi) end
 if v >= lo and (hi == nil or v < hi) then return i end
 end
 local last = t[count]
 if type(last) ~= 'number' then last = tonumber(last) or 0 end
 if v >= last then return count end
 return {none_value}
 end
 if mode == 'highest' then
 local best = 0
 for i = 1, count do
 local th = t[i]
 if type(th) ~= 'number' then th = tonumber(th) or 0 end
 if v >= th then best = i end
 end
 if best == 0 then return {none_value} end
 return best
 end
 local active = 0
 for i = 1, count do
 local th = t[i]
 if type(th) ~= 'number' then th = tonumber(th) or 0 end
 if v >= th then active = i else break end
 end
 if active == 0 then return {none_value} end
 return active
end)()

plugins.label: Round
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Round to nearest, floor, or ceil with optional decimal places. Richer than the built-in Round (nearest only).
plugins.lua_expr:
(function()
 local v, d = {value}, math.floor({decimals} + 0.5)
 if d < 0 then d = 0 end
 local m = 10 ^ d
 local mode = '{mode}'
 if mode == 'floor' then return math.floor(v * m) / m
 elseif mode == 'ceil' then return math.ceil(v * m) / m
 end
 return math.floor(v * m + 0.5) / m
end)()

plugins.label: AND (0/1)
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Logical AND with configurable truth threshold. Output 1 or 0.
plugins.lua_expr: ((({a}) >= ({threshold}) and ({b}) >= ({threshold})) and 1 or 0)

plugins.label: OR (0/1)
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Logical OR with configurable truth threshold. Output 1 or 0.
plugins.lua_expr: ((({a}) >= ({threshold}) or ({b}) >= ({threshold})) and 1 or 0)

plugins.label: NOT (0/1)
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Invert a 0/1 (or thresholded) signal. No built-in equivalent.
plugins.lua_expr: ((({value}) >= ({threshold})) and 0 or 1)

plugins.label: Pick (A/B)
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: If selector ≥ threshold output A, else B. Explicit threshold (richer than fixed 0.5 built-in).
plugins.lua_expr: ((({selector}) >= ({threshold})) and ({a}) or ({b}))

plugins.label: Percent of
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: value / total × 100. Safe when total is 0. VRAM used/total, disk used/size, etc.
plugins.lua_expr: ((({total}) ~= 0) and (({value}) / ({total}) * 100) or 0)

plugins.label: Unit Format
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Format a number with prefix, suffix, and decimals as text (e.g. 42.5 → '42.5 °C').
plugins.lua_expr:
(function()
 local v = {value}
 if type(v) ~= 'number' then v = tonumber(v) or 0 end
 local d = math.floor({decimals} + 0.5)
 if d < 0 then d = 0 end
 local s = string.format('%.' .. d .. 'f', v)
 return '{prefix}' .. s .. '{suffix}'
end)()

plugins.label: Rate Limit
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Limit how fast a value can change per refresh (max step). Unique Slot per instance.
plugins.lua_expr:
(function()
 local k = {slot}
 local v, step = {value}, {max_step}
 if step < 0 then step = 0 end
 local s = _cs_plugin_ratelimit
 if s[k] == nil then s[k] = v end
 local d = v - s[k]
 if d > step then d = step elseif d < -step then d = -step end
 s[k] = s[k] + d
 return s[k]
end)()

plugins.label: Hold Peak
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Remembers the highest value seen, with optional slow decay. Classic peak-hold for meters.

plugins.label: Modulo
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: value mod divisor. Wrapping angles, cycling indices, stepped patterns.

plugins.label: Dot
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Filled circle always on (status LED, bullet, blip). Unlike LED Dot, no threshold — colour is fixed.
plugins.lua_draw_body:
local r, g, b = {color}
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, {opacity})
 cairo_arc(cr, {x}, {y}, {radius}, 0, 2 * math.pi)
 cairo_fill(cr)

plugins.label: Data Rate Format
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Auto-scales a raw KB/s number into a human string (e.g. 1400 -> '1.4 MB/s'). Companion to Network Download/Upload, which output a raw number in KB/s.

properties.label: Use KiB/MiB/GiB (x1024)
properties.help: Off uses decimal KB/MB/GB (x1000) instead.

plugins.lua_expr:
(function()
 local v = {value}
 if type(v) ~= 'number' then v = tonumber(v) or 0 end
 local binary = {binary_prefixes}
 local base = binary and 1024 or 1000
 local u1, u2, u3, u4
 if binary then u1, u2, u3, u4 = 'KiB', 'MiB', 'GiB', 'TiB'
 else u1, u2, u3, u4 = 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB' end
 local label = u1
 local av = math.abs(v)
 if av >= base then v = v / base; av = av / base; label = u2
 if av >= base then v = v / base; av = av / base; label = u3
 if av >= base then v = v / base; label = u4 end
 end
 end
 local d = math.floor({decimals} + 0.5)
 if d < 0 then d = 0 end
 local s = string.format('%.' .. d .. 'f', v)
 return s .. ' ' .. label .. '{suffix}'
end)()

plugins.label: Text Case
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Force text to UPPER, lower, or Title Case -- e.g. normalizing Now Playing status or a weather condition string before a Text Label.
plugins.lua_expr:
(function()
 local v = tostring({value})
 local mode = '{mode}'
 if mode == 'upper' then return v:upper() end
 if mode == 'lower' then return v:lower() end
 local out = {}
 for word in v:gmatch('%S+') do
 local first = word:sub(1,1):upper()
 local rest = word:sub(2):lower()
 table.insert(out, first .. rest)
 end
 return table.concat(out, ' ')
end)()

plugins.label: Hold Min
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Remembers the lowest value seen, with optional slow relax back upward. The trough-tracking counterpart to Hold Peak -- e.g. lowest battery drain rate, coldest temp today.

properties.label: Slot
properties.help: Unique integer per Hold Min node. Shared slots share memory.

plugins.label: Badge
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: A rounded-rect status chip with centred text -- wire a category source (Playback Status, Weather Category) or a String Format output straight in for an 'ONLINE' / 'PAUSED' / 'RAIN' style pill.

properties.label: Corner radius
properties.help: Half of Height gives a full pill shape.

plugins.lua_draw_body:
local bg_r, bg_g, bg_b = {bg_color}
 local tx_r, tx_g, tx_b = {text_color}
 local w, h = {width}, {height}
 rounded_rect(cr, {x}, {y}, w, h, {corner_radius})
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, bg_r, bg_g, bg_b, 1)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 local label = tostring({text})
 cairo_select_font_face(cr, 'Sans', CAIRO_FONT_SLANT_NORMAL, CAIRO_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD)
 cairo_set_font_size(cr, {font_size})
 local ext = cairo_text_extents_t:create()
 cairo_text_extents(cr, label, ext)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, tx_r, tx_g, tx_b, 1)
 cairo_move_to(cr, {x} + w / 2 - ext.width / 2, {y} + h / 2 + ext.height / 2)
 cairo_show_text(cr, label)

plugins.label: Tick Ring
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: Decorative radial tick marks -- chrome to stack under/around an Arc Gauge, Segmented Gauge, or in place of Analog Clock's built-in ticks.
plugins.lua_draw_body:
local r, g, b = {color}
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, {opacity})
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, {tick_width})
 local n = math.floor({tick_count} + 0.5)
 if n < 1 then n = 1 end
 local step = ({sweep_deg}) / n
 for i = 0, n - 1 do
 local a = math.rad(({start_angle_deg}) + i * step)
 local x1 = {cx} + math.cos(a) * ({radius} - {tick_length})
 local y1 = {cy} + math.sin(a) * ({radius} - {tick_length})
 local x2 = {cx} + math.cos(a) * {radius}
 local y2 = {cy} + math.sin(a) * {radius}
 cairo_move_to(cr, x1, y1)
 cairo_line_to(cr, x2, y2)
 cairo_stroke(cr)
 end

plugins.label: Pulse Dot
plugins.author: conky-studio
plugins.description: A dot that pulses (grows/fades) continuously while Active is truthy, and sits dim/static otherwise -- wire a Threshold Gate, Playback Status via a comparison, or any 0/1-ish signal into Active for a 'something is happening' indicator.

properties.label: Active
properties.help: Truthy (>= 0.5) pulses; otherwise the dot sits dim and static.

plugins.lua_draw_body:
local r, g, b = {color}
 local active = ({active}) >= 0.5
 local t = wall_clock() * {speed}
 local phase = active and (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 2 * math.pi)) or 0.15
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, 0.35 + 0.65 * phase)
 cairo_arc(cr, {x}, {y}, {radius} * (0.75 + 0.25 * phase), 0, 2 * math.pi)
 cairo_fill(cr)

plugins.label: Bridge -> Number
plugins.description: Universal adapter: accepts ANY output kind (text, category, percent, celsius, number) and coerces it to a plain number. Wire this between a text/category source and a numeric-only bindable property that would normally refuse the connection.

properties.label: Value
properties.help: Accepts a wire from any node kind.

properties.label: If not a number
properties.help: Returned when Value can't be parsed as a number (e.g. empty text).

plugins.author: conky-studio

plugins.label: Bridge -> Text
plugins.description: Universal adapter: accepts ANY output kind and stringifies it. Wire this between a numeric/percent/celsius source and a text-only bindable property (e.g. Badge's Text, a String Join input) that would normally refuse the connection.
plugins.author: conky-studio

plugins.label: Bridge -> Percent
plugins.description: Universal adapter: accepts ANY output kind, coerces to a number, and (optionally) clamps it to 0-100 so it can feed a Percent-typed property (gauges, bars) from a source that isn't normally offered there.
plugins.lua_expr:
(function()
 local v = tonumber({value}) or 0
 if {clamp} then
 if v < 0 then v = 0 elseif v > 100 then v = 100 end
 end
 return v
end)()
plugins.author: conky-studio

plugins.label: Bridge -> Category
plugins.description: Universal adapter: accepts ANY output kind and turns it into a short category-style token (e.g. for an Icon node's trigger input) even when the source is really a number or free text.
plugins.author: conky-studio

plugins.label: Glass Panel
plugins.description: Frosted-glass rounded panel: translucent tint, soft top sheen, and a diagonal light streak. Cairo can't do a true gaussian blur cheaply inside a Conky draw loop, so this fakes the glassmorphism look with layered translucency instead -- drop it behind other nodes as a backing card.
plugins.lua_draw_body:
local tr, tg, tb = {tint_color}
 local x, y, w, h, rad = {x}, {y}, {width}, {height}, {corner_radius}
 rounded_rect(cr, x, y, w, h, rad)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, tr, tg, tb, {tint_opacity})
 cairo_fill(cr)
 rounded_rect(cr, x, y, w, h, rad)
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, 1)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, 1, 1, 1, {border_opacity})
 cairo_stroke(cr)
 if {sheen} then
 cairo_save(cr)
 rounded_rect(cr, x, y, w, h, rad)
 cairo_clip(cr)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, 1, 1, 1, 0.10)
 cairo_rectangle(cr, x, y, w, h * 0.42)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, 1, 1, 1, 0.16)
 cairo_move_to(cr, x, y)
 cairo_line_to(cr, x + w * 0.32, y)
 cairo_line_to(cr, x, y + h * 0.55)
 cairo_close_path(cr)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 cairo_restore(cr)
 end
plugins.author: conky-studio

plugins.label: Glass Ring
plugins.description: Circular progress ring styled like frosted glass: a translucent track, a coloured progress arc, and a small bright sheen arc near the top for a glassy highlight. A lighter-weight companion to Arc Gauge for a glassmorphism theme.
plugins.lua_draw_body:
local cx, cy, rad, tw = {cx}, {cy}, {radius}, {track_width}
 local minv, maxv = {min_value}, {max_value}
 local span = maxv - minv
 if span == 0 then span = 1 end
 local val = tonumber({value}) or minv
 local pct = clamp((val - minv) / span, 0, 1)
 local tr, tg, tb = {tint_color}
 local fr, fg, fb = {fill_color}
 cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_ROUND)
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, tw)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, tr, tg, tb, 0.22)
 cairo_new_sub_path(cr)
 cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, rad, 0, 2 * math.pi)
 cairo_stroke(cr)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, fr, fg, fb, {opacity})
 cairo_new_sub_path(cr)
 cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, rad, -math.pi / 2, -math.pi / 2 + 2 * math.pi * pct)
 cairo_stroke(cr)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, 1, 1, 1, 0.35)
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, tw * 0.35)
 cairo_new_sub_path(cr)
 cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, rad - tw * 0.28, -math.pi * 0.85, -math.pi * 0.55)
 cairo_stroke(cr)
plugins.author: conky-studio

plugins.label: Sprite / GIF-Frames Animator
plugins.description: Cycles a numbered sequence of PNG frames as an animation -- the practical way to get 'GIF' playback, since Conky's Lua has no GIF decoder. Export your GIF to numbered frames first (e.g. `ffmpeg -i in.gif frame_%03d.png`), then point Frame path pattern at that folder using a printf-style %0Nd placeholder, e.g. /home/you/.config/conky-studio/anim/frame_%03d.png. Frame files are read directly from disk at their given path (not auto-copied into the theme's images/ folder the way a single Image/Icon path is) -- keep the frame folder alongside the theme.

properties.label: Frame path pattern
properties.help: printf-style pattern with exactly one %d (or %0Nd) for the frame number.

plugins.lua_draw_body:
local pattern = '{path_pattern}'
 local count = math.floor({frame_count} + 0.5)
 if count < 1 then count = 1 end
 local fps = {fps}
 if fps <= 0 then fps = 1 end
 local t = wall_clock()
 local frame_i = math.floor(t * fps) % count
 local ok, path = pcall(string.format, pattern, frame_i + {start_index})
 if ok then
 local surf = load_image_cached(path)
 if surf then
 cairo_save(cr)
 cairo_translate(cr, {x}, {y})
 local sw, sh = {width}, {height}
 if sw > 0 and sh > 0 then
 local iw = cairo_image_surface_get_width(surf)
 local ih = cairo_image_surface_get_height(surf)
 if iw > 0 and ih > 0 then
 cairo_scale(cr, sw / iw, sh / ih)
 end
 end
 cairo_set_source_surface(cr, surf, 0, 0)
 cairo_paint_with_alpha(cr, {opacity})
 cairo_restore(cr)
 end
 end
plugins.author: conky-studio

plugins.label: CRT Scanlines
plugins.description: Overlay of horizontal scanlines (with optional flicker) across a region -- stack on top of other visuals for a retro-CRT / terminal chrome look.
plugins.lua_draw_body:
local x, y, w, h = {x}, {y}, {width}, {height}
 local spacing = {line_spacing}
 if spacing < 1 then spacing = 1 end
 local r, g, b = {color}
 local op = {line_opacity}
 if {flicker} then
 op = op * (0.75 + 0.25 * math.sin(wall_clock() * {flicker_speed} * 2 * math.pi))
 end
 cairo_save(cr)
 cairo_rectangle(cr, x, y, w, h)
 cairo_clip(cr)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, op)
 local yy = y
 while yy < y + h do
 cairo_rectangle(cr, x, yy, w, 1)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 yy = yy + spacing
 end
 cairo_restore(cr)
plugins.author: conky-studio

plugins.label: Neon Text
plugins.description: Glowing neon-tube style text: several soft translucent strokes stacked under a solid fill approximate a light-tube glow (no real blur available in the draw loop). Good for a sign/marquee-style HUD label.
plugins.lua_draw_body:
local r, g, b = {color}
 local label = tostring({text})
 local fam = '{font_family}'
 cairo_select_font_face(cr, fam, CAIRO_FONT_SLANT_NORMAL, CAIRO_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD)
 cairo_set_font_size(cr, {font_size})
 local ext = cairo_text_extents_t:create()
 cairo_text_extents(cr, label, ext)
 local align = '{align}'
 local tx = {x}
 if align == 'center' then tx = {x} - ext.width / 2 - ext.x_bearing
 elseif align == 'right' then tx = {x} - ext.width - ext.x_bearing
 else tx = {x} - ext.x_bearing end
 local ty = {y} - ext.y_bearing
 local layers = math.floor({glow_strength} + 0.5)
 if layers < 0 then layers = 0 end
 for i = layers, 1, -1 do
 local a = 0.10 * (1 - (i - 1) / math.max(layers, 1))
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, a)
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, i * 1.6)
 cairo_move_to(cr, tx, ty)
 cairo_text_path(cr, label)
 cairo_stroke(cr)
 end
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, 1)
 cairo_move_to(cr, tx, ty)
 cairo_show_text(cr, label)
plugins.author: conky-studio

plugins.label: Hex Grid
plugins.description: Decorative tiled hexagon grid chrome, with an optional every-3rd tint fill for a sci-fi HUD backdrop panel.
plugins.lua_draw_body:
local x0, y0, w, h = {x}, {y}, {width}, {height}
 local size = {hex_size}
 if size < 4 then size = 4 end
 local r, g, b = {color}
 local fr, fg, fb = {fill_color}
 local lw = {line_width}
 cairo_save(cr)
 cairo_rectangle(cr, x0, y0, w, h)
 cairo_clip(cr)
 local hex_w = size * 2
 local hex_h = math.sqrt(3) * size
 local col_spacing = hex_w * 0.75
 local row_spacing = hex_h
 local cols = math.floor(w / col_spacing) + 3
 local rows = math.floor(h / row_spacing) + 3
 local idx = 0
 for col = 0, cols do
 for row = 0, rows do
 local cx = x0 + col * col_spacing
 local cy = y0 + row * row_spacing + ((col % 2 == 1) and row_spacing / 2 or 0)
 idx = idx + 1
 cairo_new_sub_path(cr)
 for i = 0, 5 do
 local ang = math.rad(60 * i)
 local px = cx + size * math.cos(ang)
 local py = cy + size * math.sin(ang)
 if i == 0 then cairo_move_to(cr, px, py) else cairo_line_to(cr, px, py) end
 end
 cairo_close_path(cr)
 if {fill_alternate} and (idx % 3 == 0) then
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, fr, fg, fb, {opacity} * 0.5)
 cairo_fill_preserve(cr)
 end
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, {opacity})
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, lw)
 cairo_stroke(cr)
 end
 end
 cairo_restore(cr)
plugins.author: conky-studio

plugins.label: Circuit Traces
plugins.description: Decorative PCB-style right-angle trace lines with node dots. Generated once per Slot (so it stays put across frames instead of re-randomizing) -- give each instance on a project a unique Slot.

properties.label: Random seed
properties.help: Change to reshuffle the trace layout.

properties.label: Slot
properties.help: Unique integer per Circuit Traces node. Shared slots share the same layout.

plugins.lua_draw_body:
local k = {slot}
 local store = _cs_plugin_circuit
 if store[k] == nil then
 math.randomseed({seed})
 local segs = {}
 local n = math.floor({trace_count} + 0.5)
 if n < 1 then n = 1 end
 local w, h = {width}, {height}
 for i = 1, n do
 local x1 = math.random(0, math.floor(w))
 local y1 = math.random(0, math.floor(h))
 local horiz_first = math.random() > 0.5
 local x2 = math.random(0, math.floor(w))
 local y2 = math.random(0, math.floor(h))
 table.insert(segs, {x1 = x1, y1 = y1, x2 = x2, y2 = y2, horiz_first = horiz_first})
 end
 store[k] = segs
 end
 local r, g, b = {color}
 local dr, dg, db = {dot_color}
 cairo_save(cr)
 cairo_translate(cr, {x}, {y})
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, 1.5)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, {opacity})
 for _, s in ipairs(store[k]) do
 cairo_move_to(cr, s.x1, s.y1)
 if s.horiz_first then
 cairo_line_to(cr, s.x2, s.y1)
 cairo_line_to(cr, s.x2, s.y2)
 else
 cairo_line_to(cr, s.x1, s.y2)
 cairo_line_to(cr, s.x2, s.y2)
 end
 cairo_stroke(cr)
 end
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, dr, dg, db, {opacity})
 for _, s in ipairs(store[k]) do
 cairo_arc(cr, s.x1, s.y1, 2.2, 0, 2 * math.pi)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 cairo_arc(cr, s.x2, s.y2, 2.2, 0, 2 * math.pi)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 end
 cairo_restore(cr)
plugins.author: conky-studio

plugins.label: Starfield
plugins.description: Ambient drifting/twinkling stars inside a box. Positions are generated once per Slot and then animated -- give each instance a unique Slot.

properties.label: Slot
properties.help: Unique integer per Starfield node.

plugins.lua_draw_body:
local k = {slot}
 local store = _cs_plugin_starfield
 local w, h = {width}, {height}
 if store[k] == nil then
 math.randomseed({seed})
 local stars = {}
 local n = math.floor({star_count} + 0.5)
 if n < 1 then n = 1 end
 for i = 1, n do
 table.insert(stars, {sx = math.random() * w, sy = math.random() * h, sz = 0.5 + math.random() * 1.5, phase = math.random() * 6.28})
 end
 store[k] = stars
 end
 local r, g, b = {color}
 local t = wall_clock()
 cairo_save(cr)
 cairo_translate(cr, {x}, {y})
 cairo_rectangle(cr, 0, 0, w, h)
 cairo_clip(cr)
 for _, s in ipairs(store[k]) do
 local yy = (s.sy + t * {speed} * s.sz * 6) % h
 local tw = 1.0
 if {twinkle} then tw = 0.4 + 0.6 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 2 + s.phase)) end
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, tw)
 cairo_arc(cr, s.sx, yy, s.sz, 0, 2 * math.pi)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 end
 cairo_restore(cr)

plugins.label: Matrix Rain
plugins.description: Falling-glyph columns, Matrix-style. Column layout is generated once per Slot; give each instance a unique Slot.

properties.label: Slot
properties.help: Unique integer per Matrix Rain node.

plugins.lua_draw_body:
local k = {slot}
 local store = _cs_plugin_matrix
 local w, h = {width}, {height}
 local fsize = {font_size}
 if fsize < 4 then fsize = 4 end
 local cols_n = math.max(1, math.floor(w / fsize))
 if store[k] == nil then
 math.randomseed({seed})
 local cols = {}
 for i = 1, cols_n do
 table.insert(cols, {drop = math.random() * (h / fsize), speed_mul = 0.6 + math.random() * 0.8})
 end
 store[k] = cols
 end
 local r, g, b = {color}
 local dens = {density}
 cairo_save(cr)
 cairo_translate(cr, {x}, {y})
 cairo_rectangle(cr, 0, 0, w, h)
 cairo_clip(cr)
 cairo_select_font_face(cr, 'Monospace', CAIRO_FONT_SLANT_NORMAL, CAIRO_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL)
 cairo_set_font_size(cr, fsize)
 local glyphs = '01#$%&+=*<>?!'
 local glen = #glyphs
 local dt = wall_clock() * {speed}
 for i, c in ipairs(store[k]) do
 local cx = (i - 1) * fsize
 local head = (c.drop + dt * c.speed_mul) % (h / fsize + 12)
 local trail = math.floor(6 * dens)
 if trail < 1 then trail = 1 end
 for j = 0, trail do
 local row = head - j
 if row >= 0 and row * fsize <= h then
 local gi = ((math.floor(row) + i * 7 + j) % glen) + 1
 local ch = glyphs:sub(gi, gi)
 local a = 1 - (j / (trail + 1))
 if j == 0 then
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, 0.85, 1, 0.9, a)
 else
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, a * 0.85)
 end
 cairo_move_to(cr, cx, row * fsize)
 cairo_show_text(cr, ch)
 end
 end
 end
 cairo_restore(cr)

plugins.lua_draw_body:
local x, y, w, h, rad = {x}, {y}, {width}, {height}, {corner_radius}
 local pct = clamp((tonumber({value}) or 0) / 100, 0, 1)
 local lr, lg, lb = {liquid_color}
 local orr, org, orb = {outline_color}

 rounded_rect(cr, x, y, w, h, rad)

 cairo_line_to(cr, x, level_y)
 local steps = 24
 for i = 0, steps do
 local px = x + w * (i / steps)

 cairo_line_to(cr, px, py)
 end

 cairo_fill(cr)

 rounded_rect(cr, x, y, w, h, rad)

plugins.label: Radar Sweep
plugins.description: A rotating radar beam with a fading trail over concentric range rings -- pure chrome, no real 'contacts', for a sci-fi HUD corner ornament.
plugins.lua_draw_body:
local cx, cy, rad = {cx}, {cy}, {radius}
 local rr, rg, rb = {ring_color}
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, 1)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, rr, rg, rb, {opacity} * 0.5)

 if rings < 1 then rings = 1 end
 for i = 1, rings do
 cairo_new_sub_path(cr)

 end

 cairo_translate(cr, cx, cy)

 cairo_line_to(cr, math.cos(a) * rad, math.sin(a) * rad)
 cairo_stroke(cr)
 end
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, br, bg, bb, {opacity})
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, 2)
 local a0 = math.rad(ang)

plugins.label: ECG / Heartbeat Line
plugins.description: A scrolling ECG-style pulse waveform at a configurable BPM, optionally sped up by a bound Trigger (e.g. CPU % as a 'stress level'). Purely decorative -- there's no real biometric source -- but reads as a nice 'system vitals' HUD element.

properties.label: Trigger (optional)
properties.help: Optional 0-100-ish value. Higher speeds the heart rate up.

plugins.lua_draw_body:
local x, y, w, h = {x}, {y}, {width}, {height}
 local r, g, b = {color}
 local bpm = {bpm}
 local trig = tonumber({trigger}) or 0
 bpm = bpm * (1 + trig / 200)
 if bpm < 10 then bpm = 10 end
 local period = 60 / bpm
 local t = wall_clock()
 cairo_save(cr)
 cairo_rectangle(cr, x, y, w, h)
 cairo_clip(cr)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, {opacity})
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, {line_width})
 local mid = y + h / 2
 local amp = h * 0.42
 local steps = 120
 local scroll = (t / period) % 1
 for i = 0, steps do
 local frac = (i / steps + scroll) % 1
 local px = x + w * (i / steps)
 local v = 0
 if frac > 0.44 and frac < 0.5 then
 v = -0.25 * math.sin((frac - 0.44) / 0.06 * math.pi)
 elseif frac >= 0.5 and frac < 0.56 then
 v = 1.0 * math.sin((frac - 0.5) / 0.06 * math.pi)
 elseif frac >= 0.56 and frac < 0.62 then
 v = -0.35 * math.sin((frac - 0.56) / 0.06 * math.pi)
 end
 local py = mid - v * amp
 if i == 0 then cairo_move_to(cr, px, py) else cairo_line_to(cr, px, py) end
 end
 cairo_stroke(cr)
 cairo_restore(cr)

plugins.description: A row of dots, either an animated 'loading...' chase or a step-progress indicator driven by a bound percent value.

 for i = 0, n - 1 do
 local cx = x + i * (rad * 2 + gap)
 local a = 0.25
 if mode == 'loading' then
 local phase = (t - i * 0.18) % 1
 a = 0.25 + 0.75 * math.max(0, math.sin(phase * math.pi))
 else
 local pct = clamp((tonumber({value}) or 0) / 100, 0, 1)
 local active = (i + 1) / n <= pct
 if active then a = 1.0 else a = 0.2 end
 end
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, a)
 cairo_arc(cr, cx, y, rad, 0, 2 * math.pi)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 end

plugins.label: Sparkline
plugins.description: A rolling mini line chart of a bound value's recent history, buffered in memory per Slot (no built-in node keeps history over time). Auto-range or a fixed Min/Max.

properties.label: Slot
properties.help: Unique integer per Sparkline node -- each keeps its own history buffer.

plugins.lua_draw_body:
local k = {slot}
 local store = _cs_plugin_spark
 if store[k] == nil then store[k] = {} end
 local buf = store[k]
 local v = tonumber({value}) or 0
 table.insert(buf, v)
 local maxlen = math.floor({history_len} + 0.5)
 if maxlen < 2 then maxlen = 2 end
 while #buf > maxlen do table.remove(buf, 1) end
 local x, y, w, h = {x}, {y}, {width}, {height}
 local lo, hi
 if {auto_range} then
 lo, hi = buf[1], buf[1]
 for _, val in ipairs(buf) do
 if val < lo then lo = val end
 if val > hi then hi = val end
 end
 if hi - lo < 0.0001 then hi = lo + 1 end
 else
 lo, hi = {min_value}, {max_value}
 if hi - lo == 0 then hi = lo + 1 end
 end
 local r, g, b = {color}
 local n = #buf
 local pts = {}
 for i = 1, n do
 local px = x + w * (i - 1) / math.max(n - 1, 1)
 local py = y + h - clamp((buf[i] - lo) / (hi - lo), 0, 1) * h
 table.insert(pts, {px, py})
 end
 if {fill} and n > 1 then
 cairo_move_to(cr, pts[1][1], y + h)
 for i = 1, n do cairo_line_to(cr, pts[i][1], pts[i][2]) end
 cairo_line_to(cr, pts[n][1], y + h)
 cairo_close_path(cr)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, 0.22)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 end
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, 1)
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, {line_width})
 for i = 1, n do
 if i == 1 then cairo_move_to(cr, pts[i][1], pts[i][2]) else cairo_line_to(cr, pts[i][1], pts[i][2]) end
 end
 cairo_stroke(cr)

 local r, g, b = {color}
 local ar, ag, ab = {accent_color}
 cairo_save(cr)

 cairo_rotate(cr, math.rad(heading))

 cairo_new_sub_path(cr)

plugins.lua_draw_body:
local x, y, w, h = {x}, {y}, {width}, {height}
 local pct = clamp((tonumber({value}) or 0) / 100, 0, 1)
 local br, bg, bb = {body_color}
 local fr, fg, fb = {fill_color}
 local lr, lg, lb = {low_color}

 local cap_h = h * 0.4

 rounded_rect(cr, x, y, w - cap_w, h, 3)
 cairo_stroke(cr)

 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, br, bg, bb, {opacity})
 cairo_fill(cr)
 local pad = 3
 local fill_w = (w - cap_w - pad * 2) * pct
 local is_low = pct <= ({low_threshold} / 100)
 if is_low then
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, lr, lg, lb, {opacity})
 else
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, fr, fg, fb, {opacity})
 end
 if fill_w > 0 then
 cairo_rectangle(cr, x + pad, y + pad, fill_w, h - pad * 2)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 end
 local is_charging = (tonumber({charging}) or 0) >= 0.5
 if is_charging then
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, 1, 1, 1, {opacity})
 local mx, my = x + (w - cap_w) / 2, y + h / 2
 cairo_move_to(cr, mx + 4, my - h * 0.32)
 cairo_line_to(cr, mx - 5, my + 2)
 cairo_line_to(cr, mx + 1, my + 2)
 cairo_line_to(cr, mx - 4, my + h * 0.32)
 cairo_line_to(cr, mx + 5, my - 2)
 cairo_line_to(cr, mx - 1, my - 2)

 cairo_fill(cr)
 end

 end

plugins.label: Confetti Burst
plugins.description: A looping confetti fountain that plays while Active is truthy (e.g. a Threshold Gate on 'download finished' or 'goal reached') and stops spawning new pieces once Active drops -- procedural, no stored particle list, so it's cheap even with many pieces. Give each instance a unique Slot.

properties.label: Active
properties.help: Truthy (>= 0.5) plays the burst loop; otherwise nothing is drawn.

properties.label: Slot
properties.help: Unique integer per Confetti Burst node.

plugins.lua_draw_body:
local k = {slot}
 local store = _cs_plugin_confetti
 local active = (tonumber({active}) or 0) >= 0.5
 local t = wall_clock()
 if active then
 if store[k] == nil then store[k] = t end
 else
 store[k] = nil
 end
 if store[k] ~= nil then
 local elapsed = t - store[k]
 local dur = {duration}
 if dur < 0.2 then dur = 0.2 end
 local loop_t = elapsed % dur
 local n = math.floor({particle_count} + 0.5)
 if n < 1 then n = 1 end
 local cx, cy = {cx}, {cy}
 for i = 1, n do
 local pseed = i * 12.9898 + {seed}
 local ang = (math.sin(pseed) * 43758.5453) % (2 * math.pi)
 local speed = 40 + (math.abs(math.sin(pseed * 1.7)) * 80)
 local px = cx + math.cos(ang) * speed * loop_t
 local py = cy + math.sin(ang) * speed * loop_t + 0.5 * {gravity} * loop_t * loop_t
 local life = 1 - (loop_t / dur)
 if life > 0 then
 local ci = math.floor(math.abs(math.sin(pseed * 3.1)) * 3)
 local pr, pg, pb = 0.3, 0.8, 1.0
 if ci == 0 then pr, pg, pb = 1.0, 0.5, 0.3
 elseif ci == 1 then pr, pg, pb = 0.4, 1.0, 0.5
 elseif ci == 2 then pr, pg, pb = 1.0, 0.85, 0.3 end
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, pr, pg, pb, life)
 cairo_save(cr)
 cairo_translate(cr, px, py)
 cairo_rotate(cr, pseed + loop_t * 6)
 cairo_rectangle(cr, -2.5, -2.5, 5, 5)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 cairo_restore(cr)
 end
 end
 end
plugins.author: conky-studio
